83072456572220.description:
🇰🇷 See you in Jeju! Meta is bringing our latest research to #KDD2026, the premier conference dedicated to advancing data mining, machine learning, and large-scale data analytics.

🇰🇷 Jeju, South Korea
🗓️ August 11-13, 2026 
📍 Find us @ Booth #8, 9, 10

Stop by to meet our researchers, catch our exhibition talks, and dive into Meta’s accepted papers on topics including:
🧠 Generative Recommendation & Reasoning: Teaching models to reason, rank, and recommend — with verifiable logic
🤖 AI Agents & Multimodal Systems: Autonomous agents and LLMs that understand multimedia at scale
⚡ Scaling & Model Efficiency: Bending the scaling curve with Mixture-of-Experts, LoRA routing, and smarter architectures
📊 Retrieval & Measurement: From RAG vs. GraphRAG insights and CRAG-MM (our multi-modal, multi-turn RAG benchmark) to robust long-run metrics for real-world experimentation 

At Meta, we don't just publish — we build. Our research becomes the products billions rely on every day. And we're excited to connect with the world's top researchers to share our latest work. 

Passionate about advancing AI for everyone?
